# Black Sugar 21 — AI Dating Coach

> Black Sugar 21 es una app de coach de inteligencia emocional con IA para iOS y Android. No es solo una app de citas: es un asistente de psicología aplicada a las relaciones.

## What Black Sugar 21 Does

Black Sugar 21 combines a dating platform with a real-time AI coach powered by Google Gemini. The coach applies 6 evidence-based psychology frameworks (Bowlby attachment theory, Gottman's relationship research, Goleman's emotional intelligence, Hofstede's cultural intelligence, Seligman's positive psychology, and Fisher's neuroscience of attraction) to help users navigate modern dating.

## Key Features

- **AI Dating Coach**: Real-time conversation coaching in 13 languages. Suggests what to say, when to say it, and how to recover difficult situations.
- **Icebreakers & Smart Replies**: Personalized opening lines and 3-tone reply suggestions (casual / flirty / deep) based on the conversation context.
- **Multi-Universe Simulation**: Predicts how a conversation or date scenario could evolve across multiple outcomes, powered by 5 AI psychology agents debating in parallel.
- **Venue Discovery**: Suggests real date spots near the user (restaurants, cafés, parks, cultural venues) using Google Places.
- **Chemistry Score**: Real-time compatibility analysis updated every 5 messages, rated 0–100 with trend indicators (rising/falling/stable).
- **Safety Shield**: AI moderation, content filtering, emergency check-in system for first dates, and SOS escalation.
- **Photo Coach**: Gemini Vision analysis of profile photos with scoring and ranked photo order suggestions.
- **Dating Journey**: Progression system tracking milestones in a user's dating life.

## Who It's For

Singles aged 20–40 in Latin America (Chile, Mexico, Argentina), Spain, and US Hispanics. Available in Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Arabic, Indonesian, Korean, and Italian.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Full access to all core features including AI coach (3 credits/day), venue discovery, icebreakers, smart replies, chemistry score, and safety tools.
- **No paid tier**: All features are free to use.

## Psychology Research Base

The AI coach is grounded in peer-reviewed research:
- Attachment theory (Bowlby, 1969; Ainsworth, 1978; Mikulincer & Shaver, 2007)
- Relationship science (Gottman & Silver, 1994; Gottman's 5:1 ratio)
- Emotional intelligence (Goleman, 1995; Brackett & Salovey, 2006)
- Neuroscience of attraction (Fisher, 2004; Aron's 36 Questions, 1997)
- Cultural intelligence (Hofstede, 1980; Earley & Ang, 2003)
- Positive psychology (Seligman, 2011)
